description: This file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_CacheResource_Custom' which extends 'Smarty_CacheResource'. It implements an API for cache handling within the Smarty template engine, providing methods for fetching, saving, deleting, populating, and managing cache content and metadata, including lock management.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Custom
classes.description: An abstract class providing a custom cache resource handler API for the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch cached content and its modification time from data source.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Fetch cached content's modification timestamp from data source, optionally faster than loading the full cache.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Abstract method to save content to cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Abstract method to delete content from cache.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populate cached object with metadata from resource, including filepath and optional lock id.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populate cached object with timestamp and existence information.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Read cached template and process the header; evaluate content if available.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Write rendered template output to cache.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Read cached template content from cache.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear cache entries for a specific resource.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Check if cache is locked for this template.
